description: GET /v1/paymaster/limits - sponsorship limits as three blocks: platform (harness defaults), merchant (this merchant's overrides) and effective (the lower of the two, so a merchant value can never raise the effective limit above the platform's). USD fields are microdollars (x 10^6) as decimal strings; null means no limit. The platform never sets a per-tx cap, so effective.perTxCapUsdMicros is always the merchant's own. For perUserDailyCapUsdMicros the two blocks differ in reach: the merchant's value bounds sponsored ops only, the platform's applies to every op. Read-only.
name: paymaster_limits_get
title: Read paymaster spend limits
